forgot-password.question: I have forgotten my password. How do I reset it?
answer: The platform does not reset passwords. Contact the AHDA IT service desk: your password is the one you use for your AHDA account.

session-ended.question: Why does it say "Your session has ended"?
answer: For security, a session lasts a set time and then ends. Sign in again: the platform takes you back to the page you were on. Anything you had not saved is lost, so save drafts as you go.

missing-menu.question: A colleague has a menu or a screen that I do not see. Why?
answer: The menus list the platform's areas for everyone, but [[common.menu.administration]] appears only to those who administer the platform, and some screens inside a menu depend on your roles. If you need a screen or data for your work, ask your manager to request the role from the System Administrator.

missing-project.question: I cannot find a project I work on.
answer: You see a project only when one of your roles reaches it: for example as its Project Manager, through its owning sector, or through your entity. Search the [[projects.nav.register]] by title or Formal Project ID. If it is still not there, ask for the role assignment that covers it.

access-denied.question: What does "[[common.forbidden.title]]" mean?
answer: The page you opened is not available to your roles. Nothing was changed. Go back to [[common.menu.home]] or choose another screen from the menu.

too-many-requests.question: It says I made too many requests. What should I do?
answer: The platform limits how often the same action can be repeated in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.

no-data-vs-zero.question: A widget says "[[dashboards.unknown.MISSING.label]]". Is the value zero?
answer: No. It means the source has not recorded a value yet, for example because no progress has been reported. The platform never shows a missing value as zero.

live-vs-published.question: Why do the current and published figures differ?
answer: [[dashboards.semanticState.CURRENT_LIVE]] figures are the latest working values and change as work is recorded. [[dashboards.semanticState.PUBLISHED_OFFICIAL]] figures are the ones AHDA reviewed and published at the last reporting cycle. Use the published figures when you report officially.

stale.question: What does "[[dashboards.freshness.STALE]]" mean on a widget?
answer: A later report is still outstanding, so the value is shown as it stood on its as-of date. It becomes current again once the outstanding report is published.

restricted.question: Why does a figure say "[[dashboards.figure.restricted]]"?
answer: Your role may not see that figure, financial figures in particular. The rest of the dashboard is unaffected. A total that leaves restricted projects out says how many it counted.

health-entered.question: Can I set a project's health to green myself?
answer: No. [[progress.figures.overallHealth]] is calculated by the platform under AHDA's health rules. It cannot be typed or overridden.

cannot-edit-project.question: Why can I no longer edit a project's registration?
answer: The registration can be edited only while the project is [[projects.status.DRAFT]] or [[projects.status.RETURNED]]. Once it is submitted, changes go through AHDA's review; after approval, through a [[common.shell.createChangeRequest]].

no-progress-button.question: I do not see [[progress.actions.start]] on a project.
answer: Progress is reported by the project's Project Manager while the project is [[projects.status.ACTIVE]]. If you are not its Project Manager, or the project is not active yet, the button does not appear.

blocked-task.question: Why can I not complete a blocked task?
answer: A blocked task must first be resumed with [[tasks.commands.unblock]]. It can then be completed.

change-submitted.question: Can I change something after I have submitted it?
answer: Not directly. A project registration can be withdrawn until AHDA starts its review. A request you raised can be withdrawn while it is pending. An external response cannot be changed once submitted: if AHDA returns it, you correct it in a new draft.

return-or-reject.question: What is the difference between returning and rejecting a request?
answer: Returning sends the request back to its author to correct and submit again as a new revision. Rejecting ends it for good. Both need a reason, which the author reads.

scanning.question: I uploaded a file, but I cannot download it yet.
answer: Every file is checked for malware after it is received. While it is [[documents.scanState.SCAN_PENDING]] it cannot be downloaded or used as evidence. It becomes available once it is [[documents.scanState.CLEAN]]. You can close the window while the check runs.

quarantined.question: My file is [[documents.scanState.QUARANTINED]]. What now?
answer: The check found a problem with the file, and it will never be served. Check the file on your own computer and upload a clean copy. A file whose scan failed stays unavailable until a document manager chooses [[documents.rescan.action]] or a new version replaces it.

turn-off.question: Can I stop receiving e-mail or SMS notifications?
answer: Yes, for most families, in [[notifications.nav.preferences]]. In-app notifications are always on, and families marked [[notifications.preferences.mandatory]] cannot be turned off. Choose [[notifications.preferences.save]]; the change applies from the next notification sent.

mark-read.question: Can I mark a notification as unread again?
answer: No. Opening a notification marks it read, and so does [[notifications.markAll.action]]. Neither can be undone. Every notification stays in [[notifications.nav.history]].

language.question: How do I switch between Arabic and English?
answer: Open [[common.language]] in the top bar and choose the language. The choice is remembered in this browser. Text that someone typed, such as a narrative or a comment, stays in the language it was written in.
